name: ft-burn
title: ft-burn — local context waste audit for AI coding agents
description: Read-only audit of context waste across claude, codex, pi, opencode, hermes, openclaw and commandcode. Detects installed/running runtimes, shows auto-loaded memory size, cache full-rewrite share, context per request and the distillation break-even turn count as graphs. Reports the start-budget breakdown (fresh distill vs resume: working room left and rewrite cost). English by default (--lang ko for Korean). No writes, no network.

commands.name: ft-burn
commands.note: --json 은 plan_input 블록(계약 burn.v1)을 더한다. 용량·구독 산정 모드(--capacity·--inventory·--need·--scales)는 ft-plan 몫이다.

safety.note: session jsonl 에서 usage 숫자만 집계한다.

weights.note: 공개 단가 비율 근사. 실제 한도 산식은 비공개이므로 상대 비교용.
